key_responsibilities: Coordinate among local finance team, external tax agencies, local legal team to support tax audit cases across the client's group entities
Visit and liaise with in-charge ARs and tax auditors in the tax office periodically
Conduct tax health check for each entity with the assistance of external tax agencies
Use the tool advised by the external agencies during tax health checks and perform periodical tax reconciliation
Organize monthly/quarterly tax recon meetings, create and improve recon procedures
Monitor the progress of transfer pricing documentation of each entity; facilitate the progress if they are behind the schedule set by the tax director
Provide Indonesian tax training and tax knowledge to the local team and also to headquarters
